item.title: RFQ 2026/50 - NMANDD PEACEPLUS Thriving Together – Minority Community Integration programme - Capturing Culture, An Ulster-Scots Film Project
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 10,154 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-17T12:00:00Z
Competent consultancy companies are hereby invited to tender to design, develop and deliver a structured programme celebrating Ulster-Scots heritage – the project will support the integration of minority ethnic and newcomer residents living within the Mournes DEA, through a series of interactive workshops, cultural experiences and participatory film-making activities. Participants will work collaboratively to create a short documentary film that explores Ulster-Scots traditions, culture and identity.

item.title: RFQ 2026/49 - NMANDD PEACEPLUS Thriving Together – Celebrating Cultures and Diversity - 3.5 Women’s Festival
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 19,545 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-17T12:00:00Z
Competent and creative suppliers are invited to tender for the design, development, and delivery of a two-stage Women’s Festival. Stage 1 will deliver pre-festival workshops and a cross-border learning visit to build the confidence, skills and independence of women from diverse backgrounds. Activities will focus on practical life skills, wellbeing, leadership and personal development, with opportunities to build networks and learn from inspiring women and community organisations. Stage 2 will culminate in an Inclusive Women's Festival around International Women's Day 2027, celebrating participants' achievements through taster sessions, demonstrations, information stands and talks. The festival will showcase learning outcomes while encouraging attendees to access support, explore new interests and connect with local groups.
